model.sampleProtocol: One outstanding worker request; coalesce requested times; transferable Float64 positions plus per-identity availability. Manual seeks increment revision and discard old results. Displayed clock, stellar sky, selected record and all movers use the packet timestamp.
model.interpolation: None for position states. Selected model trail: 60 previous study seconds at 2-second spacing.
model.reference: Python sgp4 2.27 / independent Vallado C++ for four actual station, navigation and deep-space records; 16 vector cases at positive and negative epoch offsets.

geometry.meaning: Chord error against direct model samples only, not source prediction accuracy. Scene distances are linear Earth-radius units.

localBenchmark.scope: Propagation and Earth-fixed transforms only; excludes transfer, rendering and UI.
